title: Research: screen generic rational joint-plane supports
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Extends the exact two-plane decoder screen from binary coefficient values to generic rational coefficients. It enumerates all 65,536 4x4 support matrices, retains the 37,823 structurally nonsingular ones, and derives each generic inverse support from the perfect-matching condition on its 3x3 cofactors. These induce 439 source/reader signatures. The 391 signatures from invertible 0/1 matrices are all recovered; 48 additional generic signatures appear.

A supplementary exact C11 census exhausts all `3^16 = 43,046,721` matrices with entries in `{-1,0,1}`. Of these, 27,947,520 are invertible. Every one of their inverse-support signatures is among the same 439 generic signatures; the signed coefficient values add no new support pattern. `TERNARY-SCREEN.txt` contains an exact matrix witness for each signature, and the Python verifier validates every witness and automatically recompiles/replays the full census when a C11 compiler is available.

We price all 439 signatures on all 1,540 pairs of certified planes (676,060 cases). Every pair has minimum copy invoice 8, equal to four separate rank-two messages; there are zero strict improvements. This is a scoped negative result for generic rational bases and the complete signed-ternary coefficient alphabet. It excludes neither rational specializations outside `{-1,0,1}` with cofactor cancellation, overcomplete decoders, mixing three or more planes, coefficient scaling overhead, changed multi-array primitives, nor physical routing/restoration. No replacement coverage law, supplier or kappa improvement is claimed; selected kappa is unchanged.

## Task and overlap

Base: freshly fetched canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. Task `coverage-law-change`, **changed scope** to an exact generic-rational and signed-ternary support screen for the fixed two-plane decoder interface.

The immediate predecessor is [PR #3990](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3990), which exhausts invertible 0/1 coefficient matrices. This PR rederives that 391-signature family as a control, adds 48 generic rational signatures, and checks every signed-ternary inverse-support signature; it has no source-code dependency on #3990. Earlier related interface work includes [Discussion #1587](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587), [PR #2126](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2126), and the `paired-plane-native-payload` independent-block invoice, which leaves cross-plane mixing open.

A targeted search for `signed ternary plane decoder`, `3^16 inverse support screen` and `cofactor cancellation two-plane basis` found no external exact-term matches in the complete cached snapshot (690 open PRs and 2,580 Discussions, fetched at 08:05–08:06 UTC on 2026-10-19). The only matching PRs postdate that snapshot: #3990 is the binary predecessor and this PR is the present work. A live refresh failed because `api.github.com` was unreachable; both are reviewed directly. Broad card terms surface many related checks. These limits do not establish novelty.

## Validation

On CPython 3.12 and GCC 11.4.0, normal and optimized registered package replays passed:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/rational-joint-support-screen --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/rational-joint-support-screen
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rational-joint-support-screen --check-source-history
```

The replay cross-checks structural nonsingularity by permutation search and subset DP, checks the 22,560 invertible binary matrices and their 391 support signatures, computes pairing ranks with independent row/column elimination, verifies the ternary witnesses against exact integer adjugates, recompiles the C11 census and compares its output byte for byte, and reproduces the complete receipt. Publication-byte and source-history checks passed for commit `12b480673727b29c6ce8a0ed3cb66d9fab4f2da4`. A separate UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer run reproduced the same C receipt. No native multiplication supplier replay, physical implementation, Lean proof or selected cold replay is claimed.

## Credit

Credit the selected paired-plane matching/endpoint lineage, Discussion #1587, PR #2126, and the prior binary decoder screen in PR #3990. Prepared for Gonzalo Mier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No independent human review is claimed. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Can rational values outside `{-1,0,1}` create a cheaper cofactor-cancellation signature? The next step is to classify realizable cofactor zero patterns while keeping the determinant and every supported coefficient nonzero, starting with supports whose minors have multiple matching monomials. Any saving still needs an exact coefficient witness, a priced native interface and a restoration schedule. See `TASK.json` for the blocker.
